description: This file defines the AWS Budgets client class, which provides methods to interact with the AWS Budgets service, including creating, deleting, describing, updating budgets, actions, notifications, and related resources. It leverages inheritance from AwsClient and primarily serves as a client interface with method annotations.

classes.name: Aws\Budgets\BudgetsClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Budgets service, extending the generic AwsClient class and providing method annotations for budget-related operations.

methods.name: createBudgetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new AWS Budget.

methods.name: createBudgetActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous creation of a budget action.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates a notification for a budget.

methods.name: createSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a subscriber to a budget notification.

methods.name: deleteBudgetActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous deletion of a budget action.

methods.name: deleteSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from a notification.

methods.name: describeBudget
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific budget.

methods.name: describeBudgetAction
methods.description: Provides details of a specific budget action.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous description of a budget action.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionHistoriesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous listing of budget action histories.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionsForAccount
methods.description: Describes budget actions for an account.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionsForBudget
methods.description: Provides budget actions for a specific budget.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionsForBudgetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous retrieval of actions for a budget.

methods.name: describeBudgetNotificationsForAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous listing of notifications for an account.

methods.name: describeBudgetPerformanceHistory
methods.description: Provides historical performance data for a budget.

methods.name: describeBudgetPerformanceHistoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous retrieval of budget performance history.

methods.name: describeNotificationsForBudget
methods.description: Lists notifications associated with a budget.

methods.name: describeNotificationsForBudgetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous listing of notifications for a budget.

methods.name: describeSubscribersForNotificationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous listing of subscribers for a notification.

methods.name: executeBudgetActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous execution of a budget action.

methods.name: updateBudgetActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous update of a budget action.
